_comment: For a Cart or Checkout part whose settings are older than the look table, the look-table row (selectors.json rows) whose selector finds that part on the live page. A part whose name is a row's id with hyphens for underscores needs no entry. The verify pass (lib/part-look-verify.mjs) reads the live page through these selectors; a part with neither a row nor an entry is not verified and says so.
